text:
Anya: quick heads-up — I'm sketching a 'phase-gate' service to decouple canary decisioning from the routing plane. want feedback on tradeoffs before i write an RFC.
Darren: curious — what's the main driver? safety, observability, or reducing coupling?
Anya: all three. right now the router pulls telemetry and applies ad-hoc thresholds. it's hard to version, test, or reason about fallback order. the gate would: 1) evaluate signals, 2) emit decisions (allow/hold/fallback), 3) persist a short-lived lease for routing to consume.
Mike: lease sounds promising. how long are leases? edge cases for stale leases?
Anya: default TTL 30s for high-frequency variants, 5m for long-running experiments. router must check TTL and fall back if lease expired. ops-bot: note — TTL values will affect cache churn and DB load.
Sara: sounds like an extra network hop. latency impact on p50/p95? we need numbers.
Anya: agreed. plan is async evaluate + cache the decision in the router for 1s to avoid per-request call. warm path: router consults in-memory map, if miss -> phase-gate RPC. fallback path unchanged.
Jules: is the phase-gate authoritative? i.e., will it be the single source of truth for 'canary health'?
Anya: yes for the rollout decision surface. router still owns enforcement (routing rules, weights). phase-gate provides the decision and a confidence/token.
Darren: what signals do we ingest? raw p50/p95, error-rate, regressions on eval set?
Anya: minimal set to start: p95 latency, 5xx rate, success-rate delta vs baseline, and a quality regression score from eval service. also a secondary signal: model-variant-ooms.
Mike: can we express policies declaratively? that would help product and SREs write rules without code churn.
Anya: yes — thinking of a small DSL/JSON policy like: ```
{
  "policy_id": "faststart-variant-a",
  "window_s": 120,
  "checks": [
    {"metric": "p95_ms", "op": "<", "value": 500},
    {"metric": "error_rate", "op": "<", "value": 0.01}
  ],
  "decision": "allow",
  "cooldown_s": 300
}
```
Sara: neat. who owns policy lifecycle? product kicks it off, platform verifies?
Anya: propose: experiments team author, platform validates via dry-run and eval sandbox, SRE signs off for production gates. we need audit logs.
Darren: consider versioning — policy v2 should not invalidate existing leases mid-flight. how do we roll policies?
Anya: phase-gate returns (policy_id, policy_version, decision_token). router stores token and uses version to detect semantic change. new policy versions start with probation (canary within canary).
Mike: what about split-rollouts (A/B) where we need per-tenant or per-route exceptions?
Anya: policy scoping: global, per-model, per-tenant, per-route. evaluation uses scope precedence (route > tenant > model > global).
Jules: failure modes: gate crash, metrics lag, DB partition. fallbacks?
Anya: router fallback rules: 1) no lease -> conservative default (route config), 2) stale token -> request fresh decision with a capped backoff, 3) gate unhealthy -> route to baseline variant and increment fallback counter. also emit incident if fallback rate > threshold.
ops-bot: reminder — instrument the fallback counter and add a Grafana dashboard.
Darren: question: storage for leases — in-mem local + replicated KV for cross-pod reads? or single central Redis?
Anya: hybrid. primary in-memory per-router for speed, fallback to a small key-value store (Redis cluster) for cross-pod warmups. phase-gate persists decisions there with TTL.
Mike: estimate perf: optimistic extra p95 ~ +3ms on first miss, subsequent hits in mem ~0.1ms. need benchmarks.
Anya: action: i'll prototype gate + kv TTL semantics, run perf tests (p95 and QPS), and draft RFC with API contract example.
Sara: add a section on migration: how to flip routers to consult phase-gate incrementally (feature flag).
Jules: also include schema for audit events (policy_id, version, inputs, decision, token).
Darren: can you also list required SLO changes? e.g., routing decision latency SLO, gate availability SLO and automatic open-circuit behavior.
Anya: yep — will add SLOs and a runbook for ops.
Mike: if you want i can help with the perf harness and synthetic signals.
Anya: thanks — assign to Mike for load tests, Jules for audit schema, Sara for migration steps, Darren for SLO/runbook. i'll open RFC draft by EOD. :rocket:
platform-bot: Deploy-checklist created: phase-gate-prototype -> repo r/phase-gate (link)
ops-bot: created dashboard ticket #PLAT-3789 for fallback metrics
Anya: awesome — will post RFC link when ready.
Mike: nice, excited to see this. :+1:
